reason: The user rejected a literal every-cell veto as too strict. This prospective amendment retains a large aggregate-win requirement and bounds broad and tail regressions while allowing a small number of noisy or intrinsically unfavorable cells.
unchanged: Candidate source design, backend version, policy, and wire identity
Correctness, ABI, audit, mutation, identity, and EC2 requirements
One-shot timing rule, host, reference, fixtures, repetitions, orders, and semantic checks
The complete 1,944-cell membership and every frozen scenario, topology, outcome, window, and width
Prohibition on Rebar as design, membership, threshold, or gate input
Terminal refusal without same-identity retest, retune, or post-timing threshold change

cell_tail.empirical_quantile_method: nearest-rank: sort all 1,944 cell ratios ascending and select one-indexed rank ceil(q * 1,944)

interpretation.overall: The candidate must still deliver at least a 20% geometric-mean speedup over V17 across the complete frozen lattice.
interpretation.breadth: No frozen scenario, topology, outcome, window, or width slice may regress by more than 2% in geometric mean.
interpretation.tail: At least 99% of individual cells must be no worse than 5% slower, and no cell may be more than 10% slower. The explicit p95 condition is retained as a reported distribution check.
interpretation.correctness: Any semantic, ABI, audit, mutation, identity, or guard-page failure remains an unconditional failure.
